title: Structured logging, executed
prompt:
1. `static String format(java.util.Map<String, String> fields)` — return a
deterministic line: keys SORTED alphabetically, each as `key=value`, joined by a
single space. Empty map → empty string.
2. `static java.util.Map<String, String> parse(String line)` — the inverse: split on
single spaces, split each token on the FIRST '=', build the map.
3. `static List<String> levelOf(List<String> lines)` — extract the value of "level"
from each line via parse().
4. `static List<String> actionFor(String level)` — the level contract as data:
"ERROR"→["page"], "WARN"→["watch"], "INFO"→["ignore"], unknown→["investigate"].

tests.name: fields round-trip deterministically
